objective: Proof: for a triangulation with two marked sides one step apart, the map that keeps every distinction's odd set and moves the mark is a bijection of KF3's options at corresponding states (knot by knot, with a role change), so the two chains are isomorphic until a step adds a state; corollaries for every pair of presentations with one meeting pattern.
status: Proved 2026-11-18 (advisor-checked; referee pending): moving the ends' pair of a presentation one step round the cycle of its knots, keeping every distinction's odd set, maps KF3's options knot by knot (role changes, same pinned states, new pairs and odd set), so every two presentations of a line with one meeting pattern grow by one law until a state is added, for every n; the ends' pair decides only the number of orders.
title: Moving the ends' side carries KF3
